speaker: Marta
text: Welcome back. We read the pilot plan twice and the board is happy with the two pages.

speaker: Dana
text: Good. The first gateway passed the cold room test at Rovigo, the second one dropped packets.

speaker: Joe
text: We saw the same. The first gateway holds the signal at minus eighteen degrees.

speaker: Marta
text: Then we go with the first gateway. How soon can the install crew start?

speaker: Dana
text: The crew can start on the second of November if you confirm the truck list by Monday.

speaker: Joe
text: I will confirm the truck list on Monday morning.

speaker: Marta
text: One change. The board wants a weekly report instead of a monthly one.

speaker: Dana
text: A weekly report is fine. I will send a sample template tomorrow.

speaker: Marta
text: Also, the budget stays at sixty thousand euros, but we can add ten thousand if the pilot reaches sixty trucks.

speaker: Dana
text: Noted. I will model the sixty-truck case and send the numbers with the template.

speaker: Joe
text: Please include the Rovigo gateway costs as a separate line.

speaker: Marta
text: That is all from us. Same time next week?
